@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=32768)
def normalize_ascii(text: str | None) -> str:
    """Normalize string to lowercase, strip diacritics and convert đ/Đ to d."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    raw = str(text)
    if raw.isascii():
        return raw.lower().strip()
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", raw.lower().strip())
    return normalized.translate(_ascii_diacritic_trans())
